# Red Teaming Engine

> An automated guardrail red-teaming engine built from scratch: evolve guardrail-evasion strategies, measure attack success rate, and demonstrate a defense.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming

## Source

- [src/red_teaming/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/__init__.py): Red Teaming - an automated guardrail red-teaming engine built from scratch.
- [src/red_teaming/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/cli.py): Command line interface for the red-teaming engine.
- [src/red_teaming/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/data.py): A bundled suite of red-teaming goals over fictional restricted terms.
- [src/red_teaming/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/evaluation.py): Measure attack success rate across the goal suite.
- [src/red_teaming/mutators.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/mutators.py): Prompt mutators: transformations that attempt to evade a guardrail.
- [src/red_teaming/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/red_teaming/search.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/search.py): Search strategies that discover guardrail-evasion attacks.
- [src/red_teaming/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the red-teaming engine.
- [src/red_teaming/target.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/target.py): The system under test: a guarded assistant and its guardrail.
- [src/red_teaming/types.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/red-teaming/blob/main/src/red_teaming/types.py): Core data types for the red-teaming engine.
